The affix ङीष् is optionally used in the feminine after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending with the word in क्त having acute accent on the final, the antecedent word not being a word denoting a part of the body.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्
The affix अण् comes after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) अश्वपति etc., in the various mentioned senses antedcedently up to तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम्

The affix फञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words अश्व etc.

Terms: फञ्

The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'sown' after the word आश्वयुजी।

Terms: वुञ्

The affix अण् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the words अश्विमान् to denote bricks put up with the मन्त्र containing the word अश्विन् and the affix मतुप् is लुक् elided.

Terms: छन्दस् - अण्

The affix खञ् comes in the sense of 'what is travelled over or traversed in one day' after the word अश्व being in the Genitive 6th-Case in construction.

Terms: खञ्

The same augment अस् (असुक्) is added after the words 1. अश्व 2. क्षीर 3. वृष and 4. लवण before the Denominative affix क्यचि when the delight of the subject in these things is to be expressed.

Terms: छन्दस् substitution

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) long आ is substituted for the final of 1. अश्व and 2. अघ before the Denominative क्यच् ।

Terms: क्यच् affix
